static_elf_repair.problem: The R15 gate accepted a synthetic 'statically linked' marker that no real ldd implementation emits. Real GNU ldd on a gcc -static ELF exits 1 with stderr '\tnot a dynamic executable', so a healthy static binary failed doctor (false negative).
static_elf_repair.fix: ft_is_static_elf: header-based static-ELF detection (ELF magic + little-endian class check + od-parsed program header table; static = no PT_INTERP). Static ELF passes doctor without consulting ldd; dynamic ELF, non-ELF and unparseable files keep the unchanged fail-closed ldd path; private-lib symlink containment still runs for every binary before any static verdict.

busybox_style_env_trace_static.note: the binary silently executes; the output is the program's own and can never certify dependency health, so no output-based gate can cover busybox static diagnosis - the ELF header is the only libc-independent arbiter
